html:
Perks › Epic

Golden Double

Epic perk · Score multiplier

A scoring play with a double doubles the entire play.

In-game card text

How it works

A scoring play made with a double is doubled in full for each copy: the open-end total, every perk bonus and the Midas Touch extra all double.

  • Two copies make the play four times as large.
  • It happens after the perk bonuses are added and before The Equalizer and any maluses. See Scoring in depth.

Worked example

You play 5-5 and the ends total 20, with Double Trouble: 20 + 5 = 25. Golden Double makes it 50.

At a glance

RarityEpic
TypeScore multiplier
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 900 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Rare perks.
